{{c|''Saul not content to per{{ls}}ecute {{ls}}o cruelly in Hieru{{ls}}alem, 3 is in the vvay to Dama{{ls}}cus told by our Lord IESVS of his vaine attempt, and miraculou{{ls}}ly conuerted to be an Apo{{ls}}tle: and after great penance, re{{ls}}tored to his {{ls}}ight by Ananias, and baptized. 20 And pre{{ls}}ently he dealeth mightily again{{ls}}t the Ievves, prouing IESVS to be Chri{{ls}}t, to their great admiration. 23 But {{ls}}uch is their ob{{ls}}tinacie, that they lay al Dama{{ls}}cus to kil him, 26 From thence he goeth to Hieru{{ls}}alem, and there ioyneth vvith the Apo{{ls}}tles, and againe by the ob{{ls}}tinate Ievves his death is {{ls}}ought. 31 The Church being novv grovven ouer al Ievvrie, Galilee, and Samaria, Peter vi{{ls}}iteth al: and in his vi{{ls}}itation, 33 healing a lame man, 36 and rai{{ls}}ing a dead vvoman, conuerteth very many.''}}<noinclude>{{rh|||AND}}</noinclude>
